# `oaap disk`

disks and archives as node resources (RFC-0063): list, adopt, forget, open, eject, format, scan, archive add, path add, source list|remove, grant, revoke, verify.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap disk {list,adopt,forget,open,eject,format,scan,archive,path,source,grant,revoke,verify,archive-run} [rest] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `rest` | adopt: <uuid>; open/eject/format/scan/forget: <disk>; archive\|path add <disk> <nr\|path>; source list\|remove <source>; grant/verify: <source>; revoke: <grant> |
| `--name NAME` | adopt: the disk's name; archive/path add: the source's name |
| `--role ROLE` | adopt: raw (as delivered, never written) or work (the platform may format it) |
| `--luks-key LUKS_KEY` | adopt: key file of a LUKS disk |
| `--all` | open: every adopted disk that is plugged in (the boot unit) |
| `--luks` | format: LUKS2 + ext4 |
| `--plain` | format: ext4 only |
| `--confirm-uuid CONFIRM_UUID` | format: the disk's UUID, typed back |
| `--names` | scan: show file names (hidden by default, D7) |
| `--index-on INDEX_ON` | archive add: the work disk for the index |
| `--recursive` | archive add: show archives inside the archive as folders |
| `--instance INSTANCE` | grant/revoke: the instance |
| `--as GRANT_AS` | grant: the name under /oaap/disks in the container |
| `--rw` | grant: writable (only a path on a work disk) |
| `--owner OWNER` | grant --rw: the uid that gets the folder (default: the image's user) |
| `--optional` | grant: the instance starts without it |
| `--revoke` | source remove: take its grants away first |
| `--to TO` | verify: the work disk for the list |
| `--status` | verify: the last run and its comparison, counts only |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `list` | yes |
| `adopt` | yes |
| `forget` | yes |
| `open` | yes |
| `eject` | yes |
| `format` | yes |
| `scan` | yes |
| `archive` | yes |
| `path` | yes |
| `source` | yes |
| `grant` | yes |
| `revoke` | yes |
| `verify` | yes |
| `archive-run` | yes |
